decisive_items: irregular mass in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast
multiple lymph nodes in the left axilla
response.rationale: Imaging shows an irregular breast mass with axillary lymphadenopathy; FNAC shows varied tumor cell patterns and E-cadherin positivity, consistent with invasive ductal carcinoma. Lymph node positivity is a staging feature, not the primary diagnosis. ER/HER2 status is not provided, so R2/R3 lack support.

rejected.why: Only AR positivity is mentioned, not ER; no ER data to support ER-positive breast cancer.
No HER2 testing or result is provided; absence of mention does not confirm HER2-negative.
Axillary lymph node involvement is a staging finding, not a specific histologic diagnosis; the primary tumor is better characterized as invasive ductal carcinoma.
